name: Landing jump keeps downward momentum: a jump buffered for the landing tick keeps momentum.y
techNote: spring-clip's ledge, ceiling and Course 5 ceiling spring pointing down (the hit: momentum.y -575), and a ledge box 200x40 under the spring (top y -200, x -40-160); the finish box is the region under y -1000 (y -1220 to -1000, on a floor). OnCollisionStay2D zeroes Velocity.y and momentum.y on a (0, 1) contact, but returns first while recentlyJumped is on (2518-2526); a ground jump turns recentlyJumped on for 0.03 s (1685-1687). A jump buffered for the landing tick (pressed up to 6 ticks before) leaves on the tick the ground rays land the dot, so the floor contact that tick finds recentlyJumped on and momentum.y is kept: -365.7 here. The jump is weak (805 against -366) but the momentum carries into the next drop. Race from the spring: the landing-tick jump (released a tick later, jump cut, stick right, then down) is below y -600 on tick 77 and in the finish box on tick 90; the same jump one tick late (momentum zeroed on the landing tick, a full jump) is below -600 on tick 85 and in the box on tick 100; landing and walking off the edge is below -600 on tick 80 and in the box on tick 95.

ghosts.label: Jump one tick late: momentum zeroed
